items.title: Wanted man held after 14 months for mob attack on Delhi police team in Chhatarpur
items.text: The accused, identified as Arbaj Khan alias Baiju, a resident of Chandan Holla village in Chhatarpur, was apprehended by the Special Staff of South district from Village Gadpur in Bhiwadi on November 20, police said

items.title: Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill
items.text: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

items.title: Nvidia faces U.S. accounting probe amid deepening turmoil: media
items.text: The Securities and Exchange Commission inquiry is in its early stages, U.S. media reported, after Jensen Huang’s resignation as chief executive and a 14% fall in Nvidia shares on Friday (November 20, 2026)

items.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Sachin dazzles in Tamil Nadu’s big win over Bihar
items.text: The opener smashes 82 off 41 balls while Sai Kishore and Siddharth excel with the ball; Tejasvi runs riot for Delhi; Alam scalps four in four as Railways ends Saurashtra’s winning streak

items.title: About 3,500 runners participate in IITH half marathon 2026
items.text: IITH’s 3rd half marathon drew about 3,500 participants across four races, featuring winners Ramavath Ramesh Chandra and Sunima Dila, with Paralympic gold medallist Petkar flagging off.
